remarks: Welcome to this exceptional 3-family home offering the perfect blend of space, comfort, and income potential! Located in a desirable neighborhood, this well-maintained property features three spacious units. Ideal for owner-occupants or savvy investors looking to generate passive income. Units 1 & 2 are located in the main house.Unit 1 features 2 bedrooms & Full bath. Unit 2 features 2 bedrooms, Office/extra room, & Full bath. The Main house has a full basement. Unit 3 is a detached cottage located in back of the property. The Cottage features 2 bedrooms & 1 Full & 1 Half baths. This cottage has been totally updated. All units have a washer and dryer. Ample off-street parking. Conveniently located near public transportation, shopping, public beach and major highways. This is a rare chance to own a 3-family home in Greenwich. Don't miss this Gem.
